Man löse die Gleich. $\varphi(x,0)=0$ auf. Eine Wurzel
sei $x=h$ und es sei $\varphi(x,0)=(x-h)^2 X$ so daß
$X$ den Factor $x-h$ nicht mehr enthalte. Dann sei
$f(x,\alpha)=p+\alpha p'+\alpha^2 p''+\alpha^3 p'''$ &c so ist:

Number of irreducible polynomials of degrees 1–4 modulo p
Count of reducible degree-3 polynomials by factorization type
Lagrange-type series expansion of f(x,α) in powers of α where x is defined implicitly by φ(x,α)=0 near a root h of φ(x,0)
